findings.summary: Validation errors are shown in colour only and are not linked to their fields.
findings.fix: Set aria-describedby on each input to the id of its error text, set aria-invalid, and put the error in a live region.

findings.summary: The email field has both a label and a placeholder, so screen readers announce the name twice.
findings.fix: Remove the placeholder; the label already names the field. If the example text helps, move it to visible help text and point aria-describedby at it.

passed: Every input has a programmatically associated label
